Iwachu is a Japanese ironware manufacturer based in Morioka, Iwate Prefecture. The company was founded in 1902 and is known for producing traditional Nambu tekki (Nambu ironware), which includes cast iron teapots (tetsubin), cookware, and decorative items.

Nambu ironware has a history dating back around 400 years in the Iwate region, and Iwachu is one of the most prominent producers keeping this craft tradition alive. Their products are valued for their quality craftsmanship, durability, and the health benefits sometimes associated with cooking in cast iron.
